data.snapshot-builder.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Builds a repo snapshot: clones or fetches the configured repos
# into the scratch volume, flushes them to disk, creates a VolumeSnapshot
# repos-<UTC timestamp>, waits until it is ready and deletes all but the
# newest $KEEP. The control plane restores each task's workspace from the
# newest ready snapshot.
#
# Trusted and clone-only: it reads the real GitHub token (from the release
# namespace, through the API, so it is never stored in the sandbox namespace)
# and its egress is open on 443. It must never run repo code.
set -eu

KUBECTL="${KUBECTL:-kubectl}"
GIT="${GIT:-git}"
REPOS_DIR="${REPOS_DIR:-/repos}"
: "${REPOS:?}" "${RELEASE_NAMESPACE:?}" "${SANDBOX_NAMESPACE:?}" "${GITHUB_SECRET:?}"
: "${SCRATCH_PVC:?}" "${SNAPSHOT_CLASS:?}" "${KEEP:?}"

# On its own so that a failed read stops the run (set -e) instead of cloning
# anonymously.
encoded="$("$KUBECTL" get secret "$GITHUB_SECRET" -n "$RELEASE_NAMESPACE" -o 'jsonpath={.data.token}')"
token="$(printf '%s' "$encoded" | base64 -d | tr -d '\r\n')"
unset encoded
if [ -n "$token" ]; then
  # Via GIT_CONFIG_* env: never argv or .git/config.
  export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
  export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0="http.https://github.com/.extraheader"
  GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="Authorization: Basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$token" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
  export GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0
else
  echo "the GitHub token is empty: cloning anonymously"
fi
unset token
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

echo "$REPOS" | while read -r url branch; do
  [ -n "$url" ] || continue
  case "$url" in
    https://github.com/*/*.git) ;;
    *) echo "unsupported repo url: $url (expected https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  name="$(basename "$url" .git)"
  case "$name" in "" | . | .. | -*) echo "bad repo name in $url" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  case "$branch" in "" | -* | *..*) echo "bad branch for $url: $branch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  dir="$REPOS_DIR/$name"
  if [ -d "$dir/.git" ]; then
    echo "fetch $url ($branch)"
    "$GIT" -C "$dir" -c core.fsync=all fetch -q --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$branch:refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
    "$GIT" -C "$dir" checkout -q -f -B "$branch" "origin/$branch"
    "$GIT" -C "$dir" clean -q -ffdx
  else
    echo "clone $url ($branch)"
    rm -rf "$dir"
    "$GIT" -c core.fsync=all clone -q --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "$branch" -- "$url" "$dir"
  fi
done

if grep -lsE "x-access-token|github_pat_|gh[opsu]_" "$REPOS_DIR"/*/.git/config; then
  echo "token found in the git config files above; aborting" >&2
  exit 1
fi
sync

name="repos-${SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP:-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)}"
"$KUBECTL" create -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshot
metadata:
  name: $name
  namespace: $SANDBOX_NAMESPACE
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: devbox
    app.kubernetes.io/component: repo-snapshot
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: devbox-snapshot-builder
spec:
  volumeSnapshotClassName: $SNAPSHOT_CLASS
  source:
    persistentVolumeClaimName: $SCRATCH_PVC
EOF
"$KUBECTL" wait volumesnapshot "$name" -n "$SANDBOX_NAMESPACE" \
  --for='jsonpath={.status.readyToUse}=true' --timeout="${READY_TIMEOUT:-15m}"
echo "snapshot $name is ready"

# Oldest first; delete all but the newest $KEEP of this builder's own
# snapshots: both labels and the repos- name, so a snapshot made by hand in
# this namespace is never pruned. awk instead of `head -n -N`, which BSD head
# rejects. Same labels as control-plane/src/clients/repoSnapshots.ts.
"$KUBECTL" get volumesnapshot -n "$SANDBOX_NAMESPACE" \
  -l app.kubernetes.io/component=repo-snapshot,app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=devbox-snapshot-builder \
  --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o name \
  | awk -v keep="$KEEP" '/\/repos-[^\/]*$/ { l[++n] = $0 } END { for (i = 1; i <= n - keep; i++) print l[i] }' \
  | while read -r old; do
  "$KUBECTL" delete -n "$SANDBOX_NAMESPACE" "$old" --wait=false
done

data.bootstrap.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Creates the chart's generated secrets when they are missing:
# the OpenSandbox API key, the Postgres password, the iron-proxy CA and, with
# the GitHub token minter, an empty token Secret for it to fill, and
# copies the CA's public certificate into a ConfigMap in the sandbox
# namespace. Never replaces an existing value, so every install and upgrade
# can run it. Runs as a Helm pre-install/pre-upgrade hook (ArgoCD: PreSync).
# Kubernetes RBAC cannot limit `create` by name; this Job's Role allows
# creating Secrets in the release namespace and reading only the named ones.
set -eu

KUBECTL="${KUBECTL:-kubectl}"
NS="${RELEASE_NAMESPACE:?}"
SANDBOX_NS="${SANDBOX_NAMESPACE:?}"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
SCRATCH_PVC="${SCRATCH_PVC:?}"
STORAGE_CLASS="${STORAGE_CLASS:?}"
WORKSPACE_SIZE="${WORKSPACE_SIZE:?}"

missing() { ! "$KUBECTL" get secret "$1" -n "$NS" -o name >/dev/null 2>&1; }
random_hex() { head -c 24 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'; }

if missing devbox-opensandbox; then
  random_hex >"$WORK/api-key"
  "$KUBECTL" create secret generic devbox-opensandbox -n "$NS" --from-file="api-key=$WORK/api-key"
  echo "created secret devbox-opensandbox"
fi

if [ "${POSTGRES_ENABLED:-false}" = true ] && missing devbox-postgres; then
  random_hex >"$WORK/password"
  "$KUBECTL" create secret generic devbox-postgres -n "$NS" --from-file="password=$WORK/password"
  echo "created secret devbox-postgres"
fi

if missing devbox-iron-proxy-ca; then
  (
    umask 077
    openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -sha256 -days 3650 \
      -subj "/CN=devbox iron-proxy CA" \
      -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
      -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
      -keyout "$WORK/tls.key" -out "$WORK/tls.crt" 2>/dev/null
  )
  "$KUBECTL" create secret generic devbox-iron-proxy-ca -n "$NS" \
    --from-file="tls.crt=$WORK/tls.crt" --from-file="tls.key=$WORK/tls.key"
  echo "created secret devbox-iron-proxy-ca"
fi

# The GitHub token minter may only update its Secret (RBAC cannot limit
# create by name), so it starts empty here when the installer did not write
# one. Readers treat an empty token as not yet minted.
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN_SECRET:-}" ] && missing "$GITHUB_TOKEN_SECRET"; then
  : >"$WORK/token"
  "$KUBECTL" create secret generic "$GITHUB_TOKEN_SECRET" -n "$NS" --from-file="token=$WORK/token"
  echo "created secret $GITHUB_TOKEN_SECRET (empty until the minter writes a token)"
fi

# The public certificate for sandboxes, rewritten from the Secret on every
# run, so a deleted or stale ConfigMap heals without a new CA. The private
# key never leaves the release namespace.
"$KUBECTL" get secret devbox-iron-proxy-ca -n "$NS" -o 'jsonpath={.data.tls\.crt}' | base64 -d >"$WORK/ca.crt"
"$KUBECTL" create configmap iron-proxy-ca-cert -n "$SANDBOX_NS" \
  --from-file="ca.crt=$WORK/ca.crt" --dry-run=client -o json | "$KUBECTL" apply -f -
echo "CA certificate published to $SANDBOX_NS"

# The snapshot builder's scratch volume is created here, not by the chart:
# on a WaitForFirstConsumer StorageClass a claim binds only once a pod mounts
# it, and `helm --wait` (ArgoCD and Flux too) waits for every chart PVC to
# bind before the post-install hook that would mount this one. A claim made
# by a hook is outside that wait. Its size is fixed at creation: most classes
# cannot shrink, so a changed workspace.size is refused rather than ignored.
# The requested size is kept in an annotation: the API server stores 1024Mi
# as 1Gi, so the claim's own size cannot be compared with workspace.size.
if size="$("$KUBECTL" get pvc "$SCRATCH_PVC" -n "$SANDBOX_NS" -o 'jsonpath={.metadata.annotations.devbox\.io/workspace-size}' 2>/dev/null)"; then
  if [ -z "$size" ]; then
    echo "the scratch volume $SCRATCH_PVC was not created by devbox: its size is not checked"
  elif [ "$size" != "$WORKSPACE_SIZE" ]; then
    echo "the scratch volume $SCRATCH_PVC is $size but workspace.size is $WORKSPACE_SIZE: delete it to resize (kubectl -n $SANDBOX_NS delete pvc $SCRATCH_PVC), then run bun run k8s:refresh-snapshot --target <file>" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
else
  "$KUBECTL" create -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: $SCRATCH_PVC
  namespace: $SANDBOX_NS
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: devbox
    app.kubernetes.io/component: snapshot-builder
  annotations:
    devbox.io/workspace-size: "$WORKSPACE_SIZE"
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  storageClassName: $STORAGE_CLASS
  resources: { requests: { storage: $WORKSPACE_SIZE } }
EOF
  echo "created the scratch volume $SCRATCH_PVC ($WORKSPACE_SIZE)"
fi

data.config.yaml:
dns:
  listen: ":5353"
  # Every name a sandbox looks up resolves to iron-proxy's Service.
  proxy_ip: "10.96.0.20"
proxy:
  http_listen: ":8080"
  https_listen: ":8443"
  max_request_body_bytes: 10485760
tls:
  ca_cert: /certs/tls.crt
  ca_key: /certs/tls.key
  cert_cache_size: 500
  leaf_cert_expiry_hours: 24
transforms:
  - name: allowlist
    config:
      rules:
        - host: codeload.github.com
          methods: [GET, HEAD]
          paths: ["/*"]
        - host: github.com
          methods: [GET, HEAD]
          paths: ["/*"]
        # Clones and fetches of any repo: git-upload-pack is the read side
        # of smart-HTTP git (pushes use git-receive-pack, allowed per repo
        # below). A `*` inside a path matches one segment: /<owner>/<repo>.git
        # needs two.
        - host: github.com
          methods: [POST]
          paths: ["/*/*/git-upload-pack"]
        - host: github.com
          paths: ["/acme/widgets/*", "/acme/widgets.git/*"]
        - host: api.github.com
          paths: ["/repos/acme/widgets/*"]
        - host: raw.githubusercontent.com
          paths: ["/acme/widgets/*"]
        - host: api.github.com
          methods: [GET, HEAD]
          paths: ["/users/*"]
        - host: "*.blob.core.windows.net"
          methods: [GET, HEAD]
          paths: ["/actions-results/*"]
        - host: "llm.example.com"
          methods: [POST]
          paths: ["/v1/responses"]
  - name: secrets
    config:
      secrets:
        - source: { type: file, path: /var/run/devbox/github/token, ttl: 60s }
          proxy_value: proxy-github-dummy-token
          match_headers: [Authorization]
          rules:
            - host: github.com
            - host: api.github.com
            - host: raw.githubusercontent.com
        - source: { type: file, path: /var/run/devbox/llm/api-key, ttl: 60s }
          proxy_value: proxy-llm-dummy-token
          # api-key: Azure OpenAI's header. x-api-key: Anthropic's.
          match_headers: [Authorization, api-key, x-api-key]
          rules:
            - host: "llm.example.com"
log:
  level: info

data.batchsandbox-template.yaml:
metadata: {}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: devbox
        app.kubernetes.io/component: sandbox
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      enableServiceLinks: false
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      dnsPolicy: None
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers: ["10.96.0.20"]
      volumes:
        - name: iron-proxy-ca
          configMap: { name: iron-proxy-ca-cert }
      containers:
        - name: sandbox
          volumeMounts:
            - { name: iron-proxy-ca, mountPath: /run/iron-proxy, readOnly: true }

data.config.toml:
[server]
host = "0.0.0.0"
port = 80
max_sandbox_timeout_seconds = 86400

[log]
level = "INFO"

[runtime]
type = "kubernetes"
execd_image = "opensandbox/execd:v1.0.22"

[storage]
allowed_host_paths = []
volume_default_size = "1Gi"

[kubernetes]
kubeconfig_path = ""
namespace = "devbox-sandboxes"
informer_enabled = true
informer_resync_seconds = 300
informer_watch_timeout_seconds = 60
workload_provider = "batchsandbox"
image_pull_policy = "IfNotPresent"
batchsandbox_template_file = "/etc/devbox/batchsandbox-template.yaml"

[egress]
image = "opensandbox/egress:v1.1.7"
mode = "dns"

[renew_intent]
enabled = false
min_interval_seconds = 60


[ingress]
mode = "direct"
